posts.title: LDN 1295: The Giraffe Nebula
posts.lead: What does this image look like to you? Many see a giraffe facing right, with neck stretched high and long legs mid-stride (but some may see a squirrel instead).
posts.credit: Alessandro Merga Text: Cecilia Chirenti (NASA GSFC, UMCP, CRESST II)

posts.title: NASA Adds Relativity Space’s Terran R to Launch Services Contract
posts.lead: A NASA Launch Services (NLS) II contract has been awarded by the agency to Relativity Space Inc., and its Terran R launch service in accordance with the contract’s on-ramp provision.

posts.title: NASA’s Chandra Unveils Mysterious X-Ray Objects
posts.lead: Using NASA’s Chandra X-ray Observatory, scientists have discovered a new class of objects behaving unlike any they have seen before.

posts.title: Crew Studies Medicine and Physics, Works on Spacesuits and Earth Photo Gear
posts.lead: Vein scans, ultra-hot physics, and Earth observations were the main research activities aboard the International Space Station on Wednesday.
